results.title: Tata Steel joins UK–India circular materials research programme
results.description: Tata Steel has joined Britain's new circular materials research partnership. The three-year UK–India programme is expected to support up to 15 grants worth £100,000–£150,000, with projects beginning in April 2027. The post Tata Steel joins UK–India circular materials research programme appeared first on Industrial News.

results.title: ‘Papyrus 20’ scent is for all the readers
results.description: Le Labo has released Papyrus 20, a new scent joining the Classic Candle collection of the famous “slow perfumery” brand. Inspired by the ancient material used to preserve stories for generations to come, Papyrus 20 explores the ephemeral nature of scent and memories.

results.title: Moving Government Offices Alone Will Not Balance Growth
results.description: Korea will move 44 agencies and 9,929 civil servants to Sejong by 2031, but Sejong has zero new apartment units scheduled for move-in next year.

results.title: Nepal elected to UN Human Rights Council
results.description: KATHMANDU: Nepal has been elected to the United Nations Human Rights Council for the 2027–2029 term, securing 173 votes of the 180 votes cast in the UN General Assembly, according to Nepal's Permanent Mission to the United Nations in New York.

results.title: Greta Gerwig's Narnia Adaptation Sparks Controversy with Fever-Dream Trailer
results.description: The first trailer for Greta Gerwig's adaptation of C.S. Lewis's Narnia chronicles has ignited a firestorm of controversy online. While the film-maker celebrates capturing the surreal beauty of the Magician's Nephew, fans are divided, with many accusing the CGI-heavy production of lacking the charm and depth of the original stories.

results.description: Kamala Harris adviser Maria Cardona fires back at Democratic donors and strategists who say the former vice president blew her chance to reinvent herself.

results.title: Former Garland County public defender arrested again on purported drug charges after traffic stop
results.description: HOT SPRINGS -- An area attorney and former chief public defender who was arrested earlier this year on multiple felony drug charges after a raid on his residence was arrested again early Monday on drug and gun charges following a traffic stop.

results.title: Tsang Yow's semiconductor revenue share reaches 12%
results.description: Automotive drivetrain manufacturer Tsang Yow reported consolidated revenue of NT$86.36 million (US$2.69 million) in September 2026, down 2.3% month-over-month and 1.24% year-over-year as demand from the Americas aftermarket temporarily slowed. Supported by its semiconductor business, consolidated revenue reached NT$269 million in the third quarter of 2026, up 7.5% year-over-year, while revenue for the first nine months rose 4.04% year-over-year to NT$824 million.
